DEFENCE SAVINGS CERTIFICATES RULES, 1966
DEFENCE SAVINGS CERTIFICATES
RULES, 1966
(Amendment of R.4)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
13th August, 2011]
S.R.O.
763(I)/2011, dated 11-8-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by section
28 of the Public Debt Act, 1944 (XVIII of 1944), the Federal Government is
pleased to direct that the following further amendments shall be made in the
Defence Savings Certificates Rules, 1966, the same having been previously
published vide Notification No. S.R.O. 591(I)/2011, dated the 8th June, 2011,
as required under subsection (1) of the said section, namely:--
In
the aforesaid Rules, in rule 4,--
(i) for
sub-rule (5), the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(5)
all institutional investment shall be discontinued with immediate
effect."; and
(ii) sub-rules
(6), (7), (8), (9), (10) (1 1), (12). (13). (14), (15), (16) and (17) shall be
omitted.
